# Assess Release Readiness

Check acceptance criteria, diff, type/lint/build/test results, security findings, dependency changes, migrations, configuration, secrets, observability, SLO impact, cost, rollback, runbook, approvals, and deployment evidence. Identify missing evidence and residual risk. Return READY_FOR_REVIEW, CHANGES_REQUIRED, BLOCKED_ON_HUMAN_DECISION, or NOT_VERIFIED; do not publish or deploy.
